cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put 'butler' above your answer on the murder-mystery board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We both said butler at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Simultaneous guesses aren't deductions. List your evidence; I'll put it in order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The muddy shoes. Same evidence you used.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is written as a deduction. Yours is just 'butler'. Add the shoes underneath, and leave my answer at the top.

reason: Name the puzzle and clue. A treats B's identical result as unqualified guessing, then corrects how B records the evidence to retain first-place status.
